sources.title: Vendor harness memory (Claude auto-memory, Codex and Gemini equivalents)

canonicalStore.location: ~/.claude/projects/<project>/memory and each harness's own memory folder

retention.policy: Harness-private convenience copy; never the only home of cross-agent knowledge.
retention.supersession: Entries are updated or deleted by the harness; durable ones move to ecc-memory-vault.

state.evidence: Claude auto-memory for manageesg-backend holds 8 project-status entries and 1 runbook; on 2026-09-28 the 7 module-status entries and the runbook were copied, sanitized, into ecc-memory-vault user scope.
gaps: The Claude entries still contain customer names and property, meter and account identifiers, which this contract forbids in harness memory; scrubbing them is an operator decision because other sessions rely on them.

state.evidence: No memory server is configured in the ECC, backend, or frontend .mcp.json; the graph was empty on 2026-07-07; knowledge-ops stopped instructing mcp__memory__* writes on 2026-09-28.

retention.policy: Execution state, not durable knowledge; closed items keep their history.
